nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Greenhouse gas emission reduction|Methane emission reduction strategies_qna_000
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What method was used to measure N2O and N2 emissions?
nodes.answer: The improved 15N gas flux method with helium oxygen flushing (80:20) was used to measure N2O and N2 emissions.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Greenhouse gas emission reduction|Methane emission reduction strategies_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: Which method is applicable for quantifying N2 emissions on a field scale?
nodes.answer: The only method applicable on the field scale for quantifying N2 emissions is the 15N gas flux method (15NGF).

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Greenhouse gas emission reduction|Methane emission reduction strategies_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What is the recent improvement made to the 15N gas flux method?
nodes.answer: The recent improvement is the development of the 15NGF + method, which combines the 15N gas flux method with the HeO2 atmosphere method.
